- axioms of every probed theorem: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only. No sorry/admit/axiom/True/PUnit/arbitrary inhabitant/Nonempty gate.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY CONSTRUCTED (from actual q_v, Def 3.8(i) q-pilot OBJECT, not strip)
- paperQV D b = (paperInput D).initial.reduction.qParameter b (nonzero, contracting, log-negative);
  paperQVOrder D b = actual completed-DVR order = S1487Cand.order = order_C3 (S1527);
  |log q_b| = order_b * log 5, and order_b = |log q_b| / log 5 (q_v determines the order).
- paperQPilotDivisor D : IUTIVArithmeticDivisor (PaperFmod D) = order-weighted zero-locus divisor in S1927's global realified Frobenioid C^boxplus_mod, supported at the actual bad base prime.
  paperQPilotDivisor_deg_eq_source: deg = sum_b |log q_b| = order_C3 * log 5; paperQPilotDivisor_deg_pos: deg > 0.
  paperQPilotLogVolume D = -deg = sourceQPilotSignedLog = -localLogMagnitude S1487Cand = -order_C3*log 5 < 0.
  QVDeterminedQPilotObject packages divisor/degree/log-volume with these equalities; inhabited for every S1895PaperInput.
- R6 interface re-exported: R6Proper D P := Nonempty (QPilotAnchorIdentification D P); r6Proper_iff = S1960 reduction; r6Proper_of_equivalence / r6Proper_of_fullPolyIso are the last step a future definition must feed.

EXACT FIRST MISSING (a DEFINITION, not a proposition)
(a) paperQPilotFTimesMuStrip D : SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip PaperV constructed from paperQPilotDivisor D via the associated-pilot-object construction (IUT II Def 4.9(viii)), and
(b) its identification with the divisor.
No such functor/constructor exists in the tree: SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip has no divisor/pilot field; its only constructor is SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip.canonical; the only strips from OriginalInput are the Hodge-theater strips I.fPrimeStripAt n m (= S1487Strip n m in the concrete model). Hence no honest inhabitant of QPilotAnchorIdentification D P for the paper strip can be produced here.

TWO OBSTRUCTIONS PROVED (why the available strips cannot be R6)
(i) reducedQPilotAnchor D = S1487Strip 1 0, value monoid SourceHaarActualValueMonoid = Multiplicative {x : Real // x <= 0}; unit group TRIVIAL => (reducedQPilotTimesMu D).timesMu v is a subsingleton for all v (reducedQPilotTimesMu_subsingleton), and ANY P with R6Proper D P has Subsingleton (P.timesMu v) for all v (r6Proper_forces_trivial_timesMu). The reduced anchor's x-mu layer is vacuous in this value/unit model, so the missing definition must also change that model.
(ii) tree strips are q_v-blind: withInitial / fPrimeStripAt_withInitial keep I.fPrimeStripAt n m definitionally fixed when only the initial theta data (hence q_v) changes. Witness: S1487FaithfulInput vs S1487TwoPlaceInput have the same (1,0) strip and canonical lift but q-pilot log-volumes -L vs -2L (candidate_blind, qPilot_scalar_differs, availableStrip_not_qvDetermined). So the candidate canonical (I.fPrimeStripAt 1 0) (= qPilotFTimesMuPrimeStripAt10) cannot be certified q_v-determined.

ACTION FOR S1967 (important): OUnits D v = ((lgpStrip D).Mon v)^ is a SUBSINGLETON on the current strip, so any nontrivial OUnitsMu / x-mu Kummer construction on this strip is vacuous unless the value monoid is changed.

Also: QPilotFTimesMuPrimeStripActual.lean has NO olean (never compiled), so I did not import it; the candidate is referenced only via its defining term canonical (fPrimeStripAt 1 0), which is definitionally reducedQPilotTimesMu D (candidate_eq_reducedQPilotTimesMu).

Bookkeeping: appended a full entry to AUDIT_LEDGER.md. I did not edit coord/STATE.md or coord/queue.md to avoid conflicting with your coordination. Probes _S1968Probe1..4 remain in tmp/sheaf/xif/paper for reproducibility.
